name: Waupaca River

gaugeContext.note: This downstream USGS station has no discharge observations in the seven-day API check on November 5, 2026; its published continuous record ends in 2020. It remains a same-river reference, not a live reading or timing calibration for Cobbtown–Brainard’s Bridge.

timing.note: No reviewed flow/speed calibration is available. The county’s published paddling time, access map and correction links remain usable without a live gauge reading.

blurb: A winding Waupaca County paddling trip from Cobbtown Road to Brainard’s Bridge Park, with wooded banks, road crossings and moving-water challenges.

sections.difficulty: Moving water, rocks and occasional whitewater (county guide)
sections.notes: An approximately 8-mile county-guide trip for paddlers with some kayaking experience. Expect rocks, fallen trees and changing current. Arrange a vehicle shuttle between the named access areas; no shuttle service is included.

takeOut.sourceLocation: Distance and Parking & Access sections: Cobbtown Road/Hwy Q to Brainard’s Bridge Park

distanceEvidence.note: Approximate published trip mileage. It is independent of the generalized map line and does not establish a timing calibration.

guideTimes.conditions: Approximate paddling time from the county guide. Flow, obstacles and stops can change the trip duration; this is not a live estimate.

sections.routeReview: Approximate river-course overview. Small bends are generalized and the final 150 metres into the park’s islands and footbridges are not drawn. The takeout marker shows the park area.
